response.sql: SELECT c.city_id, COUNT(a.address_id) AS address_count, COUNT(a.address_id) / AVG(COUNT(a.address_id)) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg, COUNT(a.address_id) / SUM(COUNT(a.address_id)) OVER () AS share_of_all FROM address a JOIN city c ON a.city_id = c.city_id GROUP BY c.city_id ORDER BY share_of_all DESC LIMIT 10
